sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要市场事件

  • Today was a classic day of "moderate index performance, tech bloodbath" divergence. The three major indices appeared calm or even finished in the green (S&P ~+0.63%, Dow +0.67%, Russell 2000 leading the continued rebound). However, beneath the surface was the "open high → sharp dump around 9:50–10:00 AM" script for the third consecutive trading day. Nasdaq/semiconductors/energy plummeted intraday, with QQQ dropping as much as 3% within two hours. Capital is rotating from tech/semiconductors into defensive sectors like healthcare, consumer staples, utilities, and industrials, rather than experiencing a total collapse.
  • CPI release tomorrow morning (6/10 08:30 ET) is the biggest suspense. April CPI already surged to 3.8% (the highest since mid-2023), and energy prices are skyrocketing year-over-year due to the Iran war; professional forecasting agencies are even providing scary figures as high as 6% for Q2. The market is currently pricing in rate hikes rather than rate cuts (at least one rate hike probability is ~60% for the year).
  • New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh will host his first FOMC meeting on 6/17, widely considered "almost impossible to cut rates," with hawkish shadows looming.
  • SpaceX IPO on Friday (6/12): Priced at $135, valuation of $1.77 trillion, raising ~$75 billion—the largest IPO in history. The community unanimously interprets this as a "liquidity-draining dump."
  • BofA strategist Hartnett’s warning that "AI bubble = 2000 internet bubble top" is flooding the internet, with even retail investors' boomer dads forwarding the article.
  • Oil prices continue to soften (USO down, crude oil ~$86), despite the Strait of Hormuz remaining blocked and missile exchanges between Israel and Iran—the strange phenomenon of "fake peace talks" repeatedly suppressing oil prices continues.

社区氛围：今天的基调是恐慌、疲惫、悲观的混乱——在连续第三次被“早间暴涨、十点倾销”的地毯拉力屠杀后，之前对“V型反弹”的信心已经彻底破碎。多头难以置信，空头则在沉寂数月后得意忘形，充满了“操纵阴谋论+辞职+愤世嫉俗的围观”气氛。

恐惧/贪婪：恐惧明显占主导地位，接近恐慌； VIX 正在攀升至 20，“吓坏了，恐慌性抛售”已成为流行口号。然而，这还远未完全投降，仍有相当一部分“抄底”顽固分子不断被打耳光，这意味着贪婪之火尚未熄灭。

WSB 情绪与实际表现：存在巨大差异。标准普尔指数仅小幅波动，甚至转绿，但社区的表现就像是 1929 年一样——典型的评论是：“SPY -0.15%，而你们表现得好像下跌了 21%。”根本原因是WSB高度集中于科技/半导体/0DTE，而指数的轮动被放大为杠杆头寸的“世界末日”情景。一句话概括了这一点：“我的赌博账户是超级红色，我的严肃多元化账户是他妈的绿色。”
